title: Other insecticides, fungicides, herbicides and disinfectants

review.classification: The non-lethal vertebrate repellent belongs to the residual 3808.99 part of the selected CPC leaf. Requires exclusion of the special 34666 grouping. Raw sheep fat, other pesticides, products with lethal or distinct claimed functions and a wildlife protection service cannot share this edge.
review.primary_evidence: The EPA letter and CAES original report support a real commercial product, independently of its current manufacturer or supplier. The federal definition supplies the relevant US administrative stock/first release boundary; facility and period records determine the actual study event.
review.measurement: Separate the pre-release ledger from accepted stock. Synthetic audit in kg: opening unaccepted 10 gives current first acceptance 6 plus closing unaccepted 4. Opening already released 3 plus Q 6 plus returned previously released 1 equals onward dispatch 5 plus closing released stock 5. Q remains 6 and cancels across the combined physical perimeter. Retain gross/tare/net readings with packaging excluded. Metered energy uses 3.6 MJ/kWh. Freight needs actual transported gross tonnes and distance, together with matching provider scope. Original author added the two status ledgers, three released-custody cards and cp_released_custody. Integration binds that calculation to the same cards and protocol in both projections. Product transfer, waste, measured emission and the non-additive product fraction in effluent use disjoint outlets.
review.native_records: Independent records show an unrendered sheep-fat farm-gate Product and a carton candidate constrained by fibre composition. Neither supplies the registered finished repellent identity or actual lot packaging BOM. The archive supports Mass and Energy with the respective kg and MJ/kWh groups; actual electricity provider is a separate question.
review.readiness: Bilingual candidate/authored_methodology. Actual registered product/version, quantitative lot, first event, package specification/stock, supplier and service cover, metering, residuals and identity are study-specific. The scoped mapping neither establishes full PEF compliance nor grants scientific approval, independent translation approval or publication.

sources.role: UNSD CPC3 row 1500 for 34669 and rows 1495–1499 for 34661, 34662, 34663, 34664 and 34666. Verify jurisdiction, product and date.

EPA January 21 2026 product 71637-2 amendment cover, actual alternate commercial identities, final printed label requirement and period-specific transition. It does not prove a particular release, site or lot.

US released-for-shipment definition. Distinguishes final sales packaging and labels or customary finished-stock placement, marked/segregated holds, and possible later regulatory production through relabeling or repacking. Apply the appropriate actual place and date.

HQ W968435 dated June 15 2009, PDF pages 15–17. Different non-lethal vertebrate repellent including deer falls under 3808.99.95. This historical ruling does not classify TRICO, supply an inventory factor or settle another period’s legal qualifications.

Connecticut Agricultural Experiment Station report 23-02-CAES shows that TRICO Pro was an actual finished commercial comparison product. Neither field results nor the other experimental preparation enter product-release inventory.
European Commission PEF Annex I supports disclosed units, boundary, packaging reuse and allocation. No full product-specific PEFCR or approved performance scope is inferred.
